name: Hinge Fist
description: Punch with the arm swung out on its hinge and snapped shut at the moment of contact.

name: Hinge Guard
description: Swing both forearms shut before the chest like the leaves of a hinge to stop a straight blow.

name: Hinge Step
description: Pivot the whole body on the lead foot as on a hinge and finish facing the new line.

name: Hinge Seal
description: Swing a seal shut on the foe's elbow so the arm will not bend or strike for a span.

name: Hinge Pierce
description: Drive a narrow edge of sealed qi into the joint of the guard and swing it open.

name: Hinge Mend
description: Swing a seal shut over a gaping wound to close it in yourself or an ally.

name: Hinge Lock
description: Lock the foe's strongest joint on its hinge so that limb is dead for the length of the fight.

name: Hinge Brace
description: Brace the whole stance on a hinge of sealed qi that swings with a heavy blow and does not break.

name: Shut Hinge
description: Swing every sealed hinge shut at once so the foe is locked in every limb together.

name: Final Hasp
description: The school's closing move that snaps a hasp across the foe and swings the seal shut with a force that scales with the user's reserve.

name: Twinbolt Fist
description: Throw two punches in the school's pairing so the second drives home the bolt the first set.

name: Twinbolt Guard
description: Throw a bolt of qi across each forearm so one guard holds if the other is forced.

name: Twinbolt Step
description: Step with the second foot bolted down the instant the first has landed.

name: Twinbolt Seal
description: Bolt both of the foe's wrists in turn so neither hand may rise in answer.

name: Twinbolt Press
description: Press the foe's qi down with two bolts at once so his techniques come up weak.

name: Twinbolt Pierce
description: Throw two narrow bolts of qi a heartbeat apart through the same gap in the guard.

name: Twinbolt Cleanse
description: Bolt a spreading taint at both ends of the limb and force it out of yourself or an ally.

name: Twinbolt Lock
description: Throw two bolts across the foe's central channel so no technique can slip past the first.

name: Twinbolt Cover
description: Throw two bolts of qi across the front of yourself and an ally so a rush stalls at both.

name: Twinbolt Barrier
description: Throw two great bolts across the field so no technique below its tier may pass either one.

name: Twin Closure
description: The school's closing move that bolts the foe and the guard together in one double closure of a weight that scales with the user's reserve.

name: Dome Fist
description: Punch under a small dome of sealed qi that holds the force of the blow inside the target.

name: Dome Guard
description: Raise a low dome of sealed qi over the body so a blow slides off the curve.

name: Dome Step
description: Move with the dome carried overhead so the body is shielded at each stride.

name: Dome Turn
description: Let a strike run up the curve of the dome and off its crown away from the body.

name: Dome Seal
description: Set a small dome over the foe's chest that holds his qi inside it for a span.

name: Dome Press
description: Lower the dome onto the foe until his techniques are pressed to a trickle.

name: Dome Mend
description: Raise a dome of soft sealed qi over a wounded ally so the hurt closes unmolested.

name: Dome Cleanse
description: Hold a taint under the dome until it burns out of the blood of yourself or an ally.

name: Dome Lock
description: Lay the footing of a dome on the ground that rises and closes over any foe within it.

name: Dome Shield
description: Raise a wide dome over yourself and your allies that takes heavy blows on its crown.

name: Great Dome
description: Raise a great dome over the whole field that shields all within and bars those who come against it.

name: Closing Dome
description: The school's closing move that shuts the dome over the field so none may cross it for a span that scales with the user's reserve.

name: Capstone Fist
description: Set the blow like a capstone on the stance and drive it down with the whole body's weight.

name: Capstone Guard
description: Cap the guard with a last layer of sealed qi that no blow has yet broken through.

name: Capstone Step
description: End each step with the weight set down like a capstone so the stance is finished.

name: Capstone Seal
description: Cap every lesser seal on the foe with a last one so none may be shaken off.

name: Capstone Pierce
description: Drive a point of sealed qi through the guard to set a capstone inside the foe.

name: Capstone Mend
description: Cap a mended wound with a final seal that keeps it closed in yourself or an ally.

name: Capstone Lock
description: Set a capstone on the foe's core so that nothing he gathers can rise past it.

name: Capstone Cover
description: Spread a capstone of sealed qi over yourself and your allies that crowns every other guard.

name: Capstone Hold
description: Set a capstone on the whole of the foe's power so he can call no technique above the lowest.

name: Final Capstone
description: The school's closing move that sets the capstone over the whole field and finishes every seal beneath it with a weight that scales with the user's reserve.

name: Hushseal Palm
description: Strike with a palm that lays a thin hushseal on the point of contact.

name: Hushseal Guard
description: Hold a hushseal before the body so a blow lands without sound or echo.

name: Hushseal Step
description: Move so lightly under the hushseal that the ground gives back no sound.

name: Hushseal Press
description: Press a hushseal on the foe's chest and quiet the qi beneath it to a murmur.

name: Hushseal Pierce
description: Drive a silent point of sealed qi through the guard before the foe can react.

name: Hushseal Mend
description: Hush the pain of a wound under a hushseal and close it for yourself or an ally.

name: Hushseal Cleanse
description: Hush a curse lodged in the body until it loosens and flows out of yourself or an ally.

name: Hushseal Lock
description: Lock a hushseal on the foe's whole field so no technique stirs in him.

name: Hushseal Wave
description: Roll a wave of hushseal outward that stills the qi of every foe it crosses.

name: Hushseal Edict
description: Pronounce an edict of hush over the field so no foe within it can speak or cast.

name: Sealed Whisper
description: The school's closing move that breathes one whisper of seal across the field and stills every foe it reaches for a span that scales with the user's reserve.

name: Knotted Fist
description: Punch with a fist whose qi is tied in a hard knot that bursts on contact.

name: Knotted Guard
description: Tie the guard into a knot of qi that a blow cannot pull apart.

name: Knotted Stride
description: Tie the stance at each step so the body stays tight and the weight does not drift.

name: Knotted Sealing
description: Tie the foe's arm channel in a knot of sealed qi that will not pass his strength.

name: Knotted Press
description: Tighten a knot of qi in the foe's chest until his breath comes thin.

name: Knotted Mend
description: Tie the torn ends of a wound together with knots of sealed qi in yourself or an ally.

name: Knotted Lock
description: Tie a sworn knot in the foe's field that holds as long as the oath that tied it.

name: Knotted Cover
description: Tie a net of knots over yourself and your allies that takes heavy blows without a gap.

name: Knotted Oath
description: Tie the foe's power and his limbs together in one sworn knot that holds while the oath stands.

name: Final Knot
description: The school's closing move that draws every knot tight at once and holds the foe fast with a weight that scales with the user's reserve.

name: Anchorseal Palm
description: Strike with a palm that drops an anchor of sealed qi into the point struck.

name: Anchorseal Guard
description: Drop an anchor of qi through the legs so a blow cannot shift the stance.

name: Anchorseal Step
description: Set an anchor with each step and draw the body up to it in a steady line.

name: Anchorseal Turn
description: Hold the anchored forearm still and let a blow glance off it to the side.

name: Anchorseal Press
description: Anchor the foe's stance to the ground so he cannot rise or turn.

name: Anchorseal Pierce
description: Drive the flukes of sealed qi through the guard and into the body beneath.

name: Anchorseal Mend
description: Anchor torn flesh in place with sealed qi so it knits true in yourself or an ally.

name: Anchorseal Cleanse
description: Anchor a taint at the wound and draw it out slowly from yourself or an ally.

name: Anchorseal Lock
description: Anchor the foe's feet and his qi together so he can neither move nor cast.

name: Anchorseal Cover
description: Anchor a wide cover over yourself and your allies that holds fast under heavy blows.

name: Anchorseal Dominion
description: Anchor the user beyond reach of any lesser technique while the foe is fixed in his place.

name: Set Anchor
description: The school's closing move that sets the anchor so the user cannot be moved and the foe cannot move for a span that scales with the user's reserve.

name: Deepseal Fist
description: Punch with a fist that drives a seal deep into the body and leaves it there.

name: Deepseal Guard
description: Sink a seal deep under the guard so a blow finds nothing to grip.

name: Deepseal Step
description: Plant each step with a seal driven into the ground and move on from it.

name: Deepseal Press
description: Press a deep seal into the foe's field so his strongest techniques will not rise.

name: Deepseal Pierce
description: Thrust a deep seal through the guard so it settles in the core of the foe.

name: Deepseal Mend
description: Seat a deep seal under a grave wound to hold it shut in yourself or an ally.

name: Deepseal Cleanse
description: Seat a deep seal below a curse to cut it from its root in yourself or an ally.

name: Deepseal Lock
description: Lock the foe's deepest channel with a seal that no common blow will break.

name: Deepseal Cover
description: Cover yourself and your allies with a seal laid deeper than any strike can reach.

name: Deepseal Verdict
description: Pass the verdict of the deep seal on the foe so all his higher techniques are shut.

name: Last Deepseal
description: The school's closing move that lays the last deepseal over every foe in the field for a span that scales with the user's reserve.
